title: tibouchina nitida
intro: Tibouchina nitida, commonly known as the Purple Glow or Purple Fountain, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. This plant is prized for its beautiful, vibrant purple flowers and is often used in traditional medicine.
